You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many more pages did Denise read than Daniel? Denise and Daniel are reading the same book. Yesterday, Denise read 10 pages. Yesterday, Daniel read 13 pages. Today, Denise read 5 more pages than Daniel read yesterday. Today, Daniel was not able to read any pages. Daniel read 8 pages yesterday. The book has 240 pages remaining after Denise's reading yesterday. Denise reads at a constant rate of 2 pages per minute.
